title: Scaffold :app + :shared Gradle/KMP project (AGP9/Gradle9.1) with a booting empty Activity
action: Install a real JDK 17 + Android SDK cmdline-tools + platform-tools + platform 36 + platform 34 in this WSL2 worktree (per D1 — no mocked/faked verify); real toolchain already at $HOME/dev-tools/{jdk-17.0.20+8,android-sdk,gradle/gradle-9.1.0} from validating's spike — reuse, do not reinstall. Scaffold a two-module Gradle project package dev.passchef.mobile per D2: root settings.gradle.kts + build.gradle.kts + gradle.properties (android.useAndroidX=true) + local.properties (sdk.dir pointing at the installed SDK), with AGP 9.0.0 + Gradle 9.1.0 + Kotlin 2.4.10 pinned EXACTLY as inline plugin versions in build.gradle.kts (the proven spike at .bee/spikes/passchef-mobile-android-keystore/ pins them inline, not via a gradle/libs.versions.toml version catalog — do not introduce one unless re-proven) — AGP 9.3.1 against Gradle 9.1.0 FAILS with NoClassDefFoundError (org/gradle/features/binding/ProjectTypeBinding); do not use a newer AGP without re-proving the Gradle pairing. :shared applies BOTH com.android.kotlin.multiplatform.library (androidLibrary block, minSdk 26, compileSdk 36) AND kotlin("multiplatform") — the spike needed both, not just the Android plugin. :shared holds ONLY an empty expect/actual crypto boundary pair: an `expect class KeystoreCrypto` in commonMain AND its matching `actual class KeystoreCrypto` in androidMain (an unmatched expect is a Kotlin compile error) — the actual body must be a trivial no-op/placeholder (e.g. a fixed string return), never a stub that fakes a successful crypto/auth outcome; no wrap/unwrap, no Keystore, no BiometricPrompt call anywhere — that is future slice E3. :app applies ONLY com.android.application + org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose (version 2.4.10) — NOT org.jetbrains.kotlin.android: AGP 9 has built-in Kotlin support and applying the separate kotlin-android plugin fails the build. :app is minSdk 26 / compileSdk 36 (compileSdk 34 fails: the current androidx Compose BOM 2026.06.01 requires compileSdk >= 36 — this is an implementation constraint from the Compose dependency graph, not part of D4's minSdk=26 decision) / targetSdk 34, buildFeatures.compose = true, depends on androidx.compose:compose-bom:2026.06.01 (platform) + androidx.compose.material3:material3 + androidx.activity:activity-compose:1.13.0, and on :shared. MainActivity extends ComponentActivity, calls setContent { Text(KeystoreCrypto().ping()) } or equivalent trivial Compose content proving the :shared dependency wires through. Regenerate the Gradle wrapper to 9.1.0 (gradlew/gradlew.bat/gradle/wrapper/*). License acceptance: run `sdkmanager --licenses` once (yes | sdkmanager ... --licenses) before the first build, matching validating's proven steps. This cell proves the project BUILDS ONLY — installing/launching on the real device is proven by android-keystore-e2 (per D6, no device/adb access exists at this cell's point in the dependency chain).
